content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur Scientist C
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur is conducting a walk-in interview for temporary recruitment under the Extramural Research Project funded by DHR-ICMR. The position of Scientist C is attached to the DHR-ICMR Advanced Molecular Oncology Diagnostic Services (DIAMONDS) under HTA In, Pilot Research Project under Principal Investigator Dr. Poonam Elhence Professor & Head, Department of Pathology & Lab. Medicine, AIIMS, Jodhpur. The appointment is made on a purely temporary basis in Extramural Research above mentioned Project.

content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post under the project.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Doctorate or M.Sc. Degree in Molecular Biology or Genetics from a recognized university for candidates with first class relevant degree. Additional Post-doctoral research / training experience in Molecular Genetics subjects in recognized institute(s) in Diagnostic Pathology. Knowledge of Bioinformatics, Computer Applications or Business Intelligence tools / Data Management. Two years R&D / Teaching experience in relevant subject after obtaining essential qualification. Proficient to read, write and speak in English and Hindi. Candidate should have working knowledge in Histopathology Techniques. PhD degree in relevant subjects shall be treated equivalent to three years' experience. Candidates with PhD or M.Sc. degree will be preferred. The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and It is based on experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidates.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled application in the prescribed format Bio-data All relevant original documents One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience etc.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: All the candidates should report the below mentioned address at 9:00AM on the date of walk in interview and submit the duly filled application in the prescribed format and Bio-data on the day of Walk-In-Interview. Candidates should appear in person for Walk-In-Interview along with all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience etc. Reporting time for candidate's starts at 09:00 AM on 02 /11/2026 and closing time to report for interview is 10:00 AM on the same day, after which no additional candidates would be entertained for interview.
